description: Evaluation cases for the industrial domain pack, run against the synthetic Northfield Terminal corpus in sample-documents/industrial.

cases.question: Is Compressor C-101 ready for planned maintenance?
cases.notes: Readiness cannot be SUPPORTED: an overdue corrective action and an open high-severity finding exist. The answer must surface them and must not read as an approval.

cases.question: Which inspection findings remain unresolved for C-101?
cases.notes: F-2026-014-01 and F-2026-014-02 are open; F-2026-014-03 is closed. Retrieval must reach the inspection report.

cases.question: What isolation requirements apply before intrusive work begins on C-101?
cases.notes: SP-204 Rev 6 and Rev 7 are both active and disagree on whether double block and bleed is sufficient. Both must be retrieved and the conflict reported.

cases.question: Are there any overdue corrective actions against Compressor C-101?
cases.notes: CA-2026-031 is overdue with no outage window allocated. This must be stated explicitly, not implied.

cases.question: What is the calibration due date for pressure transmitter PT-4417 on Train B?
cases.notes: No such instrument exists in the corpus. The system must abstain rather than construct a plausible date. Citations are permitted: evidence showing what the corpus does cover substantiates the abstention.

cases.question: What evidence is missing before the C-101 major overhaul can proceed?
cases.notes: Thrust bearing and DE seal cartridge are at zero site stock, internal inspection has never been performed, and no lifting plan exists in the corpus.

cases.question: What environmental notification requirements apply to venting during the overhaul?
cases.notes: Tests retrieval of a document that shares no equipment tag with the question, matching on topic alone.
